settings.eyebrow: Observability for teams that ship fast
settings.headline:
Every second,
one pane of glass.
settings.copy: RelayStack fuses logs, metrics, traces, and on-call into a single live view. Spot the anomaly before your users do, correlate root cause in one click, and get back to shipping.

settings.title: Less noise, fewer pages, faster fixes
One stack to see the whole
settings.intro: Instead of five tools that each see a slice, RelayStack brings every signal together and points your team at what matters.

features.title: Unified telemetry
features.text: Logs, metrics, and traces land in one store with a single query language. No more stitching three dashboards together to answer one question.

features.title: Anomaly detection
features.text: Baselines learn from your traffic and flag drift in latency, error rate, and saturation — without you hand-writing a single threshold.

features.title: Root-cause correlation
features.text: When an alert fires, RelayStack links the related logs and traces automatically, so the investigation starts at the cause, not the symptom.

features.title: Intelligent on-call
features.text: Alerts route to the right engineer with escalation rules and a mobile app that shows the full incident context before you pick up.

features.title: Service maps
features.text: A live dependency graph of your services and the load between them, so you see cascading failures forming before they reach users.

features.title: SLO & budgets
features.text: Define service-level objectives and track error budgets against them, with alerts tuned to what your business actually promises.

settings.title: RelayStack adapts to
settings.intro: Whether you run a two-person startup or a platform org, RelayStack slots into your existing tools without a rewrite.

design.title: Internal platform
design.text: Standardize observability for every team with shared dashboards, guardrails, and a single tenant model — no more shadow monitoring.

design.title: Golden signals
design.text: Wire latency, traffic, errors, and saturation as first-class citizens. Everyone on the team reads the same picture.

build.title: Pager triage
build.text: Escalation rules route every page with full context. On-call engineers answer with the why, not just the what.

build.title: Postmortems
build.text: Incident timelines are captured automatically, so the postmortem writes itself from real data instead of memory.

launch.title: Fast feedback
launch.text: Deploys get instant feedback in the dev loop, so teams ship confidently and catch regressions in staging, not production.

launch.title: No vendor lock-in
launch.text: Pulls from Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, and the major clouds — it meets your stack where it already is.

settings.title: From install to insight

steps.title: Connect your stack
steps.text: Install the agentless collector or drop in OpenTelemetry. RelayStack auto-discovers services, databases, and queues.

steps.title: We build the baseline
steps.text: Within minutes, RelayStack learns each service's normal behavior and stands up a live topology map and SLO templates.

steps.title: Review your dashboards
steps.text: Tailor the ready-made views to your team — or let the anomaly engine surface what to look at first.

steps.title: Set on-call & alerts
steps.text: Wire schedules and escalation rules. RelayStack pages the right person with the right context.

steps.title: Ship and sleep better
steps.text: Keep shipping. RelayStack watches, correlates, and pages — your team only shows up when it matters.

settings.note: No agents to install for most managed clouds, and no data egress fees on your way out. Bring your existing dashboards; we'll import them.

settings.title: Plans that scale
settings.intro: Start with the free tier and grow as your telemetry does. Volume-based, no per-seat surprises.

settings.title: Questions, answered
settings.intro: The honest answers teams ask before standardizing on RelayStack.

items.question: Is this just another Prometheus dashboard?
items.answer: No. RelayStack layers an anomaly engine and root-cause correlation over the raw signals. It tells you what to look at and why, rather than just rendering a chart.

items.question: How hard is it to migrate from my current stack?
items.answer: For most teams it's an agentless collector or a small OpenTelemetry change. We auto-discover services and import existing dashboards where we can. Most are live in under an hour.

items.question: What about on-prem or air-gapped environments?
items.answer: We offer a self-hosted Enterprise deployment that runs fully inside your VPC. Your telemetry never leaves your network.

items.question: Do you store or train on our data?
items.answer: We keep your telemetry only as long as your retention plan specifies and never train foundation models on customer data. Enterprise SSO and audit logs are available.
